scope: exploratory fixed-feature out-of-fold INDUCTIVE clustering; not trained neural HAMV-CC
split_design: 5 mutually disjoint stratified test folds; train folds overlap
fit_protocol: Encoder/scaler/PCA, reliability predictor and k-means fit on TRAIN only; k-means.predict TEST
test_corruptions: rotation, crop, bleed not used to fit estimators or k-means
training_corruptions: Gaussian, salt-and-pepper, blur, illumination to fit reliability
posthoc: yes, new exploratory experiment, not prospective preregistration
label_usage: stratified fold construction and held-out ARI/NMI ONLY
limitations: all three pseudo-views derived from same digits image
neural encoders, contrastive loss and residual branch not trained
training clusters fitted to clean yet masked source, test corruptions OOD
test folds mutually disjoint but training folds overlap
